lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 部長、プロジェクト、完了、本当に。
lines.en: Boss, we've completed the project. Really.
lines.style: Slight breathless rush on the opening—pride and relief mingled. Warm, steady delivery. Pause before 'really' to let the weight of it land. Quiet conviction, not performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: You really did well. All of you.
lines.style: Firm, clear opening. Not effusive—the kind of praise that matters because it's measured. Slight warmth underneath the composure. A nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I'm grateful to everyone. So grateful.
lines.style: Earnest, eyes down slightly. The second 'grateful' is softer, more personal—checking himself for showing too much. Gentle pace. Reverent almost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一緒に、本当、ここまで、来た。
lines.en: We got here together. Every step.
lines.style: Steady, philosophical tone. Not looking back in regret—looking at the present moment with quiet recognition. Slow pace. The finality of someone who sees what was built.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: The company became something we can be proud of.
lines.style: Soft opening, then building slight warmth on 'proud.' Not boastful—genuine, almost surprised by the accomplishment. Trailing off into quiet satisfaction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: これからも、本当、頼んだ。
lines.en: I'm counting on you going forward. I mean that.
lines.style: Direct and warm. The second sentence is quieter, more personal—not backing down from the ask, but softening it with sincerity. A hand-on-shoulder moment in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I'll give my absolute best. Always.
lines.style: Respectful bow in the voice without ceremony. Quiet conviction on 'absolute.' Not desperate—steady, like a promise being kept. Final word trails with quiet certainty.
